message:
fix(update): recover repeated Git download interruptions (#189818)

Retry transient updater Git fetch/clone failures with bounded 1s/5s/15s backoff inside the original deadline. Settle each clone transaction and clean partial artifacts before retrying; stop on permanent failures or uncertain cleanup and warn for each retry.

The 245-line test allocation covers native HTTP recovery and distinct retry, deadline, cleanup, cancellation, authority, and permanent-error regressions.
